tweets.text: Bitcoin just slipped below $60K and is staring down a back-to-back quarterly loss — something we haven't seen since 2014-2015. Down 53% from the $126K ATH. History says this pattern either precedes a multi-year bear or marks the capitulation bottom.

Tether is sitting on $23 BILLION in gold and now wants to lend against it. A stablecoin company becoming one of the world's largest bullion-backed lenders — we're watching a shadow bank emerge in real time.

So much for "digital gold" — BTC is tracking gold and silver's selloff almost tick for tick. DXY above 108, Fed talking hikes, and Bitcoin acting like a risk asset again. The non-correlation thesis is having a rough week.

Binance failed to get its EU MiCA license and now Coinbase is offering zero-fee BTC/EUR trading to poach its 450M+ users. OKX is circling too. The biggest redistribution of crypto market share in years is happening right now.
